                      <div class="title-desc-inner" data-collection-id="58c3b9a91b631bea2c2f08ce" data-edit-main-image="Background">
                        <div class="page-title-wrapper"><h1 class="page-title" data-content-field="title">The Resort</h1></div>
                        <br> 
                        <div class="page-desc" data-content-field="description"><p>Incredible Beachfront View</p></div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
          <section id="content-wrapper">
            <div class="content">
              <div class="content-inner" data-content-field="main-content">
                <div class="sqs-layout sqs-grid-12 columns-12" data-type="page" data-updated-on="1735618186893" id="page-58c3b9a91b631bea2c2f08ce"><div class="row sqs-row"><div class="col sqs-col-12 span-12"><div class="row sqs-row"><div class="col sqs-col-6 span-6"><div class="sqs-block html-block sqs-block-html" data-block-type="2" data-sqsp-block="text" id="block-yui_3_17_2_18_1489215212250_73551"><div class="sqs-block-content">
<div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content>
  <h2 style="white-space:pre-wrap;">accommodation for WINGFOILERS, kitesurfers &amp; WINDSURFERS</h2><h1 style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Cosy, sustainable,<br>on the kitespot</h1><h3 style="white-space:pre-wrap;">KiteParadise is located right on the kitespot, facing the sand baR, overlooking the action on the water.&nbsp;</h3><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>Kitesurf, Windsurf, Kitefoil &amp; Wingfoil !</strong></p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">KiteParadise was built with passion for pristine nature, wind, and amazing watersports. The kite and funboard resort aims to build it's own little community, a tribe of fellow water sports lovers to share the stoke.&nbsp;The wind blows from mid-March to late December!</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong><br>Accommodation</strong><br>KiteParadise, facing the famous sand bank, is the only accommodation in Sakalava Bay allowing you to jump straight from your room onto the water with your kitesurf or windsurf. </p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">We offer different options of solid bungalows (no insects!) with <strong>private bathrooms</strong> : our newest and superb <strong>Chameleon Suites, designed for groups of 5 guests, feet on sand</strong>; the impressive <strong>Baobab Suites have a direct access to the Lounge terrace</strong>, and our adorable Zebus Bungalows are <strong>located on the dunes</strong>.</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">At KiteParadise Madagascar, you also have the opportunity to experience our <strong>“A” shaped Maki Bungalows</strong>, tastefully furnished, in an area entirely protected from the wind.</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong><br>Entertainment</strong><br>At night join us in the <strong>The Paradise Lounge</strong>&nbsp;for a jam and drinks.&nbsp;The Paradise Bar is equipped with musical instruments and a sound system, perfect for jams and live bands in the evenings.&nbsp;Our facilities also include a communal terrace on the ground floor that extends the reception and restaurant area inside the building and a panoramic sundeck on the roof of the kite resort. We also sell some necessities as there are no shops nearby Sakalava. </p>
</div>

<div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content>
  <h2 style="white-space:pre-wrap;">THE paradise lounge</h2><h1 style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Drink, Dance,<br>jaM, Make Friends</h1><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">From kitesurfers to kitesurfers, KiteParadise was built with passion for pristine nature, wind, on this amazing kitesurf &amp; windsurf spot. The kite resort aims to build it's own little community, a tribe of fellow wingfoilers, kitesurfers and windsurfers to share the stoke.&nbsp;</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">We'll meet here in the morning for breakfast, during the day we'll boost the motivation up with some<strong> awesome tunes</strong> to keep you going on the water, and at night we'll open the stage to our visitors and local bands.&nbsp;The Tribe Bar is equipped with musical instruments and a sound system, perfect for some jams and live gigs. Everyone is welcome to join in and make some music.&nbsp;</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Our Wifi is free and the Internet is provided by <strong>Starlink</strong>. This high speed satellite connexion allows <strong>digital nomads</strong> to work seemlessly with a fast 270Mb/s bandwidth!</p>
